passage_1:
Wanted: Counter Assistant at Marlowe’s Cheese Room

Marlowe’s Cheese Room, a specialist food shop in the old market quarter, is looking for a friendly and reliable counter assistant to join our small team. We are committed to selling carefully chosen produce and to serving our customers properly.

Responsibilities include:

  • Welcoming customers and helping them choose products
  • Operating the cash register
  • Maintaining cleanliness in the counter and the shop floor

Requirements:

  • Willingness to work at weekends
  • Confident spoken communication
  • Prior experience in retail (preferred but not required)

Employee Benefits:

  • Competitive hourly rate plus a commission of monthly sales
  • Staff discount on everything we stock

Please note that the shop trades from 9:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. Monday to Friday, and from 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. on Saturday and Sunday. To apply, e-mail your résumé to jobs@marlowescheese.com by 30 April. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
